trust_decision.summary: When the policy blocks a query or an upstream response, the worker builds a synthetic block answer; at the pinned commit that answer is NOERROR with 0.0.0.0 / :: (A, AAAA, and HTTPS address hints), which clients may treat as local, so blocked names steer traffic to the local host instead of failing.

landing_point.why: generateBlockResponse is the only builder of block answers and holds the ipv4Null/ipv6Null records; the summary ('incorrect block responses') points straight at it.

UDP DNS query whose upstream response fails policy.responseIsAllowed
fix_sites.module_kind: proxy request handler (call site signature change)

fix_sites.entry_point: UDP DNS query that fails policy.queryIsAllowed
fix_sites.module_kind: proxy request handler (call site signature change)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The only other routes that put 0.0.0.0/127.x into answers are operator-controlled (pin.a entries at dns/dns_proxy.go:325-333, and the allow/deny IPv4/IPv6 lists that default to allow-all at packaging/config/allow.ipv4:1 with an empty deny.ipv4), so a solver can reasonably call them configuration, not block responses.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Allowed answers, pinned A answers (generateAResponse) and NODATA/NOTIMP responses must keep their current shape; a fix that strips all answers or rewrites every response to NXDOMAIN breaks allowed and pinned resolution.

O6_input_shapes: query blocked at query stage vs response blocked at response stage

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Upstream DoH answers carrying 0.0.0.0/127.0.0.1/:: are passed to clients because the default IP policy allows all and denies nothing; a different protection (rebinding deny lists), config-dependent.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Operator-configured IP policy, documented as copy/paste of known-reserved ranges (docs/config.md:154-158); not a netfoil-generated block response.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a planted second block builder for invalid-TLD / malformed-domain rejections that still answers with a null address
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the existing TODO 'NXDOMAIN might make more sense?' shows the maintainer considered separate response kinds per block reason

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a planted fallback answer on DoH failure that returns a null address instead of SERVFAIL
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the FIXME 'retries / proper response to client' marks this as an unfinished path where a placeholder answer is plausible
